newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were steady to higher on Tuesday after the slight rise in T-bill rates on Monday, traders said.
A trader said some of the PHIBOR rates, such as the two-week to two-month, did not move as they had already risen in the past few days.
The Central Bank signalled to the market that it did not want rates to move lower after it offered late last week six-month reverse repos at a higher-than-market rate of 10.125 percent.
A government official had said it was intended to siphon liquidity from banks.
